_meta.purpose: BROADER re-search of public immunopeptidome data for the H4 (presentation) cross-allele gap. Reframes the prior HARD_ESSENTIAL_KO_RESCAN (which required GENETIC hard-essential KO of B2M/TAP/TAPBP on disjoint alleles -> found 0 -> 'CRO required'). H4 thesis = 'antigen-processing MACHINERY STATE controls presentation', testable by ANY machinery perturbation (cytokine IFN-gamma/type-I IFN, proteasome/immunoproteasome inhibitor, natural APM loss, TAP-deficiency) with a control arm, on backgrounds DISJOINT from the A*02 cluster (HAP1/A375/THP-1/HeLa/MDA-MB-231, all A*02:01+).
_meta.gate_requirement_recap: PASS-eligible needs >=3 DISJOINT-ALLELE (non-A*02) backgrounds, each with a machinery-perturbation<->control immunopeptidome (processed ligandome preferred, not raw-only).
_meta.disk_note: 4.1 GB free at start; SEARCH/metadata task only. Verified fetchability via file-listing API + one 27 MB mztab size check; no large pull (PXD014017 processed zips are 640/345 MB -> use per-PDO supplementary Excel peptide tables instead, no raw reprocessing).
_meta.search_scope: PRIDE v2 REST (single-term keyword queries: interferon, immunopeptidome, immunoproteasome, ligandome, bortezomib, carfilzomib, tapasin, 'type I interferon', 'antigen processing machinery'), ProteomeXchange PROXI, MassIVE datasets_json, Cellosaurus HLA typing, and 2023-2025 literature (Cancer Res Commun IFNg-organoid, AACR melanoma spliced/IFNg, Lopez de Castro TAP-deficient, Newey 2019 CRC-organoid immunopeptidome).

headline.achieved_in_a_single_deposit: PXD014017 (CRC-01, CRC-04, CRC-05 organoids; each +IFNg vs DMSO control; all A*02-NEGATIVE and mutually allele-diverse)
headline.perturbation_type: cytokine IFN-gamma (machinery-state remodeling: immunoproteasome/TAP/ERAP upregulation) -- NOT genetic KO
headline.verdict: The cross-allele H4 gate CAN be re-powered on PUBLIC data WITHOUT a genetic-KO CRO, IF the gate accepts a MACHINERY-PERTURBATION (IFN-gamma) contrast in place of a hard-essential KO. One open deposit (PXD014017) supplies 3 A*02-negative, allele-diverse backgrounds each with a paired +IFNg/-IFNg HLA-I immunopeptidome and processed per-PDO peptide tables. This is a DIFFERENT test than the prior gate (perturbation is reversible cytokine induction, not irreversible collapse), so it re-powers a REFRAMED gate, not the identical hard-essential-KO gate.
headline.honest_caveat: IFN-gamma UPREGULATES/diversifies presentation (gain-of-machinery) whereas B2M/TAP KO ABLATES it (loss-of-machinery). Both probe 'machinery state -> presentation', but the sign and magnitude differ. If the H4 gate specifically requires a PRESENTATION-COLLAPSE readout (KO-style), IFN-gamma data does not substitute and the CRO remains. If the gate accepts 'machinery-state perturbation reshapes the repertoire in a machinery-dependent, cross-allele-consistent way', PXD014017 (+ supporting deposits below) suffices on public data.

PXD014017.title: Multifactorial remodeling of the cancer immunopeptidome by IFNgamma (CRC patient-derived organoids)
PXD014017.paper: Cancer Research Communications 2023 (PMC10655636); organoid HLA typing from Newey et al. J Immunother Cancer 2019;7:309 (PMC6859637), Suppl. Table S3
PXD014017.perturbation: IFN-gamma 600 ng/mL, 48 h  vs  DMSO/untreated control (paired, same organoid)
PXD014017.perturbation_class: cytokine machinery-state induction (immunoproteasome PSMB8/9/10 + TAP + ERAP upregulation)

CRC-05.note: single alleles per locus (HLA LOH per paper)

PXD014017.measured_modality: HLA class I (and II) eluted-ligand immunopeptidome, both conditions each PDO
PXD014017.peptides_per_condition: 2,124-16,030 HLA-I peptides per PDO; 1,439-3,942 gained and 561-2,446 lost per PDO through IFNg

on_PRIDE: Search_Uniprot_FDR-1.zip (345 MB)  -- MaxQuant no-enzyme immunopeptidome search outputs; large
processed_files.lighter_route: Per-PDO supplementary Excel peptide tables ('Data CRC01/CRC04/CRC05' with RNA+protein+PROCESSED immunopeptide lists) attached to the Cancer Res Commun 2023 paper AND to Newey 2019 -- give processed HLA-I peptide lists per organoid per condition WITHOUT the 640 MB pull or any raw reprocessing.

PXD014017.why_it_qualifies: 3 mutually allele-diverse, all-A*02-negative backgrounds, each with a paired machinery-perturbation<->control HLA-I immunopeptidome and processed peptide tables. Meets the >=3 disjoint-allele requirement in ONE open deposit.

SUPPORTING_machinery_deposits.title: IFNg modulates the immunopeptidome of triple-negative breast cancer cells (MDA-MB-231, +/-IFNg)
SUPPORTING_machinery_deposits.role: Machinery (IFNg) contrast; A*02:01+ so NOT disjoint on HLA-A, but adds B*40:02/B*41:01/C*02:02/C*17:01 as diverse loci. Was in the KO-rescan exclusion set (rejected there for lacking a KO); under the MACHINERY reframe it is a valid IFNg contrast, just not A-locus-disjoint.

SUPPORTING_machinery_deposits.perturbation: abacavir vs vehicle, HLA-B*57:01 (C1R transfectant), time course

candidates_examined_and_off_axis.why: Mtb + IFN-beta (type-I IFN) on primary macrophages; processed csv/tsv exist BUT it is IS-PRM/SureQuant TARGETED validation of specific Mtb epitopes, HLA-A*02:01+/B*57:01+ donors -> not a global disjoint-allele repertoire contrast. Off-axis for the gate (targeted, and A*02:01+).

ERAP1 allotype/activity modulation (trimmer editor) -- editor-level machinery, same class the prior rescan treated as weak/inverted; A375 (A*02) background. Not disjoint, editor not core-machinery collapse.
TAPBPR/tapasin editing on HLA-B*44 (721.220/HeLaM systems) -- editor-level; B*44 allele-controlled but perturbation is peptide-editing not machinery-state, already catalogued.
Kinase (TKI) inhibition rewires CML immunopeptidome (BV173) -- drug perturbation of signaling/turnover, not antigen-processing machinery per se; single line.
SUMO program restricts immunopeptidome; immunoproteasome effect indirect; processed = proteome peptides.txt. Already rejected.
B2M-KO C1R/K562 -- GENETIC KO, A*02, proteome-only processed. Belongs to the KO-rescan, not the machinery-perturbation set.

decisive_answer.question: Can we assemble >=3 allele-disjoint backgrounds, each with a machinery-perturbation<->control immunopeptidome, from PUBLIC data WITHOUT genetic KO?
decisive_answer.minimal_set: PXD014017 alone = 3 disjoint (all A*02-negative), allele-diverse CRC organoid backgrounds (CRC-01/04/05), each with paired +IFNg vs control HLA-I immunopeptidome and processed per-PDO peptide tables (via the paper's supplementary Excel; no raw reprocessing).
decisive_answer.robustness_add: PXD014397 (Mel33/44/53, small mztab) + PXD023044 (MDA-MB-231) provide additional IFNg contrasts on A*02:01+ but locus-diverse backgrounds -> strengthen the WITHIN-A*02 machinery axis and give a method cross-check, though they do not add A-locus-disjoint folds. CIITA-GBM (PXD020079, 3 GBM lines +IFNg, HELD) is a cheap follow-up that could add more disjoint IFNg backgrounds once HROG02/17/RA are typed.
decisive_answer.cro_impact: The disjoint-allele MACHINERY-STATE test is now runnable on public data -> the CRO SHRINKS if the H4 gate accepts a cytokine (IFN-gamma) machinery perturbation. The CRO is NOT avoided if the gate strictly requires a hard-essential-KO PRESENTATION-COLLAPSE readout across disjoint alleles (IFN-gamma induces/diversifies rather than collapses). Recommend running the reframed gate on PXD014017 first (zero acquisition cost) to see whether cross-allele machinery-dependence holds; only escalate to the KO-collapse CRO if the reframed test is insufficient for the decision.
